<div class="sr-only" id="announcer" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  var STORAGE_KEY = 'even-keel:trip:v1';
  var MAX_CENTS = 1000000000; // $10,000,000.00

  var money = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-CA', { style: 'currency', currency: 'CAD' });
  function fmt(cents) { return money.format(cents / 100); }

  var listFormat = (typeof Intl.ListFormat === 'function')
    ? new Intl.ListFormat('en-CA', { style: 'long', type: 'conjunction' })
    : null;
  function joinNames(names) {
    if (listFormat) return listFormat.format(names);
    if (names.length < 2) return names.join('');
    return names.slice(0, -1).join(', ') + ' and ' + names[names.length - 1];
  }
  function plural(n, one, many) { return n + ' ' + (n === 1 ? one : many); }
  function nameKey(s) { return String(s).trim().normalize('NFC').toLocaleLowerCase('en-CA'); }
  function uid() { return Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8); }

  var ICON_X = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M4 4l8 8M12 4l-8 8" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/></svg>';
  var ICON_ALERT = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><circle cx="10" cy="10" r="8.25" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"/><path d="M10 5.6v5.2" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="10" cy="14" r="1.1" fill="currentColor"/></svg>';
  var ICON_SAVED = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6.75" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"/><path d="M5 8.2l2 2 4-4.2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>';
  var ICON_WARN = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6.75" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"/><path d="M8 4.6v4" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="8" cy="11.2" r=".9" fill="currentColor"/></svg>';
  var AVATAR_TINTS = ['#DCE7EE', '#F6DED4', '#ECE3CF', '#DAE6DD', '#E2E5EA'];

  var AMOUNT_MESSAGES = {
    empty: 'Enter how much it cost, like 42.50.',
    format: 'Enter the amount as a number, like 42.50.',
    comma: 'Use a period for cents, like 42.50.',
    decimals: 'Use at most 2 decimal places, like 42.50.',
    nonpositive: 'The amount needs to be more than $0.00.',
    toolarge: 'Amounts can be up to ' + fmt(MAX_CENTS) + '. Check the number and try again.'
  };

  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }

  function el(tag, attrs) {
    var node = document.createElement(tag);
    if (attrs) {
      Object.keys(attrs).forEach(function (key) {
        var value = attrs[key];
        if (value === null || value === undefined || value === false) return;
        if (key === 'class') node.className = value;
        else if (key === 'text') node.textContent = value;
        else if (key === 'html') node.innerHTML = value;
        else node.setAttribute(key, value === true ? '' : String(value));
      });
    }
    for (var i = 2; i < arguments.length; i++) {
      var child = arguments[i];
      if (child === null || child === undefined || child === false || child === '') continue;
      node.append(child);
    }
    return node;
  }

  /* ---------- State and storage ---------- */

  function emptyState() { return { people: [], expenses: [] }; }

  function sortIdsByTrip(ids, people) {
    var order = new Map(people.map(function (p, i) { return [p.id, i]; }));
    return ids.filter(function (id) { return order.has(id); })
      .sort(function (a, b) { return order.get(a) - order.get(b); });
  }

  function sanitize(data) {
    var out = emptyState();
    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return out;
    var keys = new Set();
    var ids = new Set();
    (Array.isArray(data.people) ? data.people : []).forEach(function (p) {
      if (!p || typeof p.id !== 'string' || typeof p.name !== 'string') return;
      var name = p.name.trim();
      if (!name || ids.has(p.id) || keys.has(nameKey(name))) return;
      ids.add(p.id);
      keys.add(nameKey(name));
      out.people.push({ id: p.id, name: name });
    });
    var seen = new Set();
    (Array.isArray(data.expenses) ? data.expenses : []).forEach(function (x) {
      if (!x || typeof x.id !== 'string' || seen.has(x.id)) return;
      var description = typeof x.description === 'string' ? x.description.trim() : '';
      var cents = x.cents;
      if (!description || !Number.isSafeInteger(cents) || cents <= 0 || cents > MAX_CENTS) return;
      if (!ids.has(x.payerId)) return;
      var split = sortIdsByTrip(Array.isArray(x.splitIds) ? Array.from(new Set(x.splitIds)) : [], out.people);
      if (!split.length) return;
      seen.add(x.id);
      out.expenses.push({
        id: x.id, description: description, cents: cents,
        payerId: x.payerId, splitIds: split, createdAt: Number(x.createdAt) || 0
      });
    });
    return out;
  }

  var store = (function () {
    try {
      var s = window.localStorage;
      var probe = '__even_keel_probe__';
      s.setItem(probe, '1');
      s.removeItem(probe);
      return s;
    } catch (e) { return null; }
  })();
  var storageOk = !!store;

  function load() {
    if (!store) return emptyState();
    try {
      var raw = store.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      return raw ? sanitize(JSON.parse(raw)) : emptyState();
    } catch (e) { return emptyState(); }
  }

  function save() {
    if (!store) { storageOk = false; return; }
    try {
      store.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify({ version: 1, people: state.people, expenses: state.expenses }));
      storageOk = true;
    } catch (e) { storageOk = false; }
  }

  var state = load();
  var unchecked = new Set();     // people the user has unticked in the split
  var lastRemoved = null;        // { expense, index } for undo
  var justAddedId = null;
  var formSig = null;
  var planSig = null;
  var renderedUndoKey = null;
  var savedNoteState = null;
  var currentTransfers = [];
  var errors = { person: null, expense: null };

  /* ---------- Elements ---------- */

  var els = {
    savedNote: $('saved-note'),
    personForm: $('person-form'), personName: $('person-name'), personErrorSlot: $('person-error-slot'),
    peopleList: $('people-list'), peopleEmpty: $('people-empty'), peopleCount: $('people-count'), peopleNote: $('people-note'),
    expenseForm: $('expense-form'), desc: $('expense-desc'), amount: $('expense-amount'),
    payer: $('expense-payer'), payerHint: $('payer-hint'),
    split: $('expense-split'), splitFieldset: $('split-fieldset'), splitTools: $('split-tools'),
    splitAll: $('split-all'), splitNone: $('split-none'), splitEmpty: $('split-empty'), preview: $('split-preview'),
    descErrorSlot: $('desc-error-slot'), rowErrorSlot: $('row-error-slot'), splitErrorSlot: $('split-error-slot'),
    expenseErrorSlot: $('expense-error-slot'), expenseStatus: $('expense-status'),
    statTotal: $('stat-total'), statMeta: $('stat-meta'),
    keelKey: $('keel-key'), balanceList: $('balance-list'), balanceEmpty: $('balance-empty'), balanceLegend: $('balance-legend'),
    settleSub: $('settle-sub'), transferList: $('transfer-list'), copyRow: $('copy-row'), copyBtn: $('copy-plan'), copyStatus: $('copy-status'),
    expensesTitle: $('expenses-title'), expensesCount: $('expenses-count'), undoSlot: $('undo-slot'),
    expenseList: $('expense-list'), expensesEmpty: $('expenses-empty'),
    reset: $('reset'), resetStart: $('reset-start'), resetConfirm: $('reset-confirm'), resetYes: $('reset-yes'), resetNo: $('reset-no'),
    announcer: $('announcer')
  };

  /* ---------- Helpers ---------- */

  function personById(id) {
    for (var i = 0; i < state.people.length; i++) if (state.people[i].id === id) return state.people[i];
    return null;
  }
  function nameOf(id) { var p = personById(id); return p ? p.name : 'Someone'; }

  function usedPersonIds() {
    var s = new Set();
    state.expenses.forEach(function (x) {
      s.add(x.payerId);
      x.splitIds.forEach(function (id) { s.add(id); });
    });
    return s;
  }

  function initials(name) {
    var words = name.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    if (!words.length) return '?';
    var first = Array.from(words[0])[0] || '';
    var last = words.length > 1 ? (Array.from(words[words.length - 1])[0] || '') : '';
    return (first + last).toLocaleUpperCase('en-CA');
  }

  function avatarEl(person) {
    var idx = state.people.indexOf(person);
    var a = el('span', { class: 'avatar', 'aria-hidden': 'true', text: initials(person.name) });
    a.style.setProperty('--av', AVATAR_TINTS[(idx < 0 ? 0 : idx) % AVATAR_TINTS.length]);
    return a;
  }

  var announceTimer = null;
  function announce(message) {
    els.announcer.textContent = '';
    clearTimeout(announceTimer);
    announceTimer = setTimeout(function () { els.announcer.textContent = message; }, 60);
  }

  /* ---------- Money ---------- */

  function parseAmount(raw) {
    var s = String(raw == null ? '' : raw).trim();
    if (s === '') return { ok: false, reason: 'empty' };
    if (/^[-\u2212]/.test(s)) return { ok: false, reason: 'nonpositive' };
    s = s.replace(/^\+/, '').replace(/^(CA)?\$/i, '').replace(/\s+/g, '');
    if (s === '') return { ok: false, reason: 'empty' };
    if (/^\d{1,3}(,\d{3})+(\.\d*)?$/.test(s)) s = s.replace(/,/g, '');
    else if (/^\d*,\d{1,2}$/.test(s)) return { ok: false, reason: 'comma' };
    if (!/^(\d+\.?\d*|\.\d+)$/.test(s)) return { ok: false, reason: 'format' };
    var dot = s.indexOf('.');
    var intPart = dot === -1 ? s : s.slice(0, dot);
    var frac = dot === -1 ? '' : s.slice(dot + 1);
    if (frac.length > 2) return { ok: false, reason: 'decimals' };
    var intDigits = intPart.replace(/^0+/, '');
    if (intDigits.length > 8) return { ok: false, reason: 'toolarge' };
    var cents = Number(intDigits || '0') * 100 + Number((frac + '00').slice(0, 2));
    if (cents <= 0) return { ok: false, reason: 'nonpositive' };
    if (cents > MAX_CENTS) return { ok: false, reason: 'toolarge' };
    return { ok: true, cents: cents };
  }

  // Equal split in integer cents. ids must be in trip order; leftover cents go
  // one each to the first people in that order.
  function splitShares(cents, ids) {
    var n = ids.length;
    var base = Math.floor(cents / n);
    var rem = cents - base * n;
    return ids.map(function (id, i) { return { id: id, cents: base + (i < rem ? 1 : 0) }; });
  }

  function computeBalances() {
    var map = new Map(state.people.map(function (p) { return [p.id, { person: p, paid: 0, share: 0 }]; }));
    state.expenses.forEach(function (x) {
      var payer = map.get(x.payerId);
      if (payer) payer.paid += x.cents;
      splitShares(x.cents, sortIdsByTrip(x.splitIds, state.people)).forEach(function (s) {
        var entry = map.get(s.id);
        if (entry) entry.share += s.cents;
      });
    });
    return state.people.map(function (p) {
      var e = map.get(p.id);
      return { person: p, paid: e.paid, share: e.share, balance: e.paid - e.share };
    });
  }

  // Each transfer clears at least one person (exact matches clear two),
  // so there are never more than (non-zero people - 1) transfers.
  function computeTransfers(balances) {
    var order = new Map(state.people.map(function (p, i) { return [p.id, i]; }));
    var debtors = [];
    var creditors = [];
    balances.forEach(function (b) {
      if (b.balance < 0) debtors.push({ id: b.person.id, amt: -b.balance });
      else if (b.balance > 0) creditors.push({ id: b.person.id, amt: b.balance });
    });
    function byAmount(a, b) { return (b.amt - a.amt) || (order.get(a.id) - order.get(b.id)); }
    debtors.sort(byAmount);
    creditors.sort(byAmount);
    var out = [];
    debtors.forEach(function (d) {
      var c = creditors.find(function (x) { return x.amt > 0 && x.amt === d.amt; });
      if (c && d.amt > 0) {
        out.push({ from: d.id, to: c.id, cents: d.amt });
        c.amt = 0;
        d.amt = 0;
      }
    });
    var ds = debtors.filter(function (d) { return d.amt > 0; });
    var cs = creditors.filter(function (c) { return c.amt > 0; });
    var i = 0, j = 0;
    while (i < ds.length && j < cs.length) {
      var amt = Math.min(ds[i].amt, cs[j].amt);
      out.push({ from: ds[i].id, to: cs[j].id, cents: amt });
      ds[i].amt -= amt;
      cs[j].amt -= amt;
      if (ds[i].amt === 0) i++;
      if (cs[j].amt === 0) j++;
    }
    out.sort(function (a, b) {
      return (order.get(a.from) - order.get(b.from)) || (order.get(a.to) - order.get(b.to));
    });
    return out;
  }

  /* ---------- Errors ---------- */

  function setDescribedBy(node, id, on) {
    var ids = new Set((node.getAttribute('aria-describedby') || '').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean));
    if (on) ids.add(id); else ids.delete(id);
    if (ids.size) node.setAttribute('aria-describedby', Array.from(ids).join(' '));
    else node.removeAttribute('aria-describedby');
  }

  function showError(key, slot, message, opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    clearAllErrors();
    var id = key + '-error';
    var msg = el('p', { class: 'form-error', id: id, 'data-testid': 'form-error', html: ICON_ALERT });
    msg.append(el('span', { text: message }));
    slot.replaceChildren(msg);
    if (opts.field) {
      opts.field.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
      setDescribedBy(opts.field, id, true);
    }
    if (opts.group) {
      opts.group.classList.add('is-invalid');
      setDescribedBy(opts.group, id, true);
    }
    errors[key] = { slot: slot, field: opts.field || null, group: opts.group || null };
    if (key === 'expense') els.expenseStatus.textContent = '';
    var target = opts.focus || opts.field;
    if (target && document.activeElement !== target) target.focus();
  }

  function clearError(key) {
    var e = errors[key];
    if (!e) return;
    var id = key + '-error';
    if (e.field) {
      e.field.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
      setDescribedBy(e.field, id, false);
    }
    if (e.group) {
      e.group.classList.remove('is-invalid');
      setDescribedBy(e.group, id, false);
    }
    e.slot.replaceChildren();
    errors[key] = null;
  }

  function clearAllErrors() { clearError('person'); clearError('expense'); }

  /* ---------- Rendering ---------- */

  function renderSavedNote() {
    var next = storageOk ? 'ok' : 'fail';
    if (next === savedNoteState) return;
    savedNoteState = next;
    if (storageOk) {
      els.savedNote.classList.remove('is-warning');
      els.savedNote.innerHTML = ICON_SAVED + '<span>Saves automatically in this browser</span>';
    } else {
      els.savedNote.classList.add('is-warning');
      els.savedNote.innerHTML = ICON_WARN + '<span>This browser isn’t saving your trip. Keep this tab open.</span>';
    }
  }

  function renderPeople() {
    var used = usedPersonIds();
    var n = state.people.length;
    els.peopleCount.textContent = plural(n, 'person', 'people');
    els.peopleCount.hidden = n === 0;
    els.peopleEmpty.hidden = n > 0;
    els.peopleList.hidden = n === 0;
    els.peopleNote.hidden = !(n > 0 && used.size > 0);
    els.peopleList.replaceChildren.apply(els.peopleList, state.people.map(function (p) {
      var canRemove = !used.has(p.id);
      var li = el('li', { class: 'person-chip' + (canRemove ? ' can-remove' : '') },
        avatarEl(p),
        el('span', { class: 'person-name', 'data-testid': 'person', text: p.name })
      );
      if (canRemove) {
        li.append(el('button', {
          type: 'button', class: 'chip-remove', 'data-remove-person': p.id,
          'aria-label': 'Remove ' + p.name, html: ICON_X
        }));
      }
      return li;
    }));
  }

  function renderFormOptions() {
    var sig = state.people.map(function (p) { return p.id + '\u0000' + p.name; }).join('\u0001');
    if (sig === formSig) return;
    formSig = sig;
    var n = state.people.length;
    var prev = els.payer.value;
    els.payer.replaceChildren.apply(els.payer, state.people.map(function (p) {
      return el('option', { value: p.name, text: p.name });
    }));
    els.payer.disabled = n === 0;
    if (n) {
      var keep = state.people.some(function (p) { return p.name === prev; });
      els.payer.value = keep ? prev : state.people[0].name;
    }
    els.payerHint.hidden = n > 0;
    els.split.replaceChildren.apply(els.split, state.people.map(function (p) {
      var input = el('input', { type: 'checkbox', name: 'split', value: p.name, 'data-id': p.id });
      input.checked = !unchecked.has(p.id);
      return el('label', { class: 'check' }, input, el('span', { text: p.name }));
    }));
    els.splitEmpty.hidden = n > 0;
    els.splitTools.hidden = n < 2;
  }

  function checkboxes() {
    return Array.from(els.split.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]'));
  }

  function checkedIds() {
    var ids = checkboxes()
      .filter(function (c) { return c.checked; })
      .map(function (c) { return c.getAttribute('data-id'); })
      .filter(function (id) { return !!personById(id); });
    return sortIdsByTrip(ids, state.people);
  }

  function updatePreview() {
    var total = state.people.length;
    if (!total) { els.preview.textContent = ''; return; }
    var ids = checkedIds();
    var n = ids.length;
    if (!n) { els.preview.textContent = 'No one is selected yet. Choose who this was for.'; return; }
    var names = ids.map(nameOf);
    var parsed = parseAmount(els.amount.value);
    var text;
    if (!parsed.ok) {
      if (n === 1) text = 'The whole amount is ' + names[0] + '’s share.';
      else if (n === total) text = 'Split equally between everyone (' + n + ' people).';
      else text = 'Split equally between ' + n + ' people.';
    } else if (n === 1) {
      text = names[0] + '’s share is the full ' + fmt(parsed.cents) + '.';
    } else {
      var base = Math.floor(parsed.cents / n);
      var rem = parsed.cents - base * n;
      if (!rem) {
        text = 'That’s ' + fmt(base) + ' each for ' + n + ' people.';
      } else {
        var part = function (amt, list) {
          return fmt(amt) + (list.length > 1 ? ' each' : '') + ' for ' + joinNames(list);
        };
        text = 'That’s ' + part(base + 1, names.slice(0, rem)) + ' and ' + part(base, names.slice(rem)) + '. ' +
          (rem === 1
            ? 'The extra cent goes to whoever was added to the trip first.'
            : 'The ' + rem + ' extra cents go one each to the people added to the trip first.');
      }
    }
    els.preview.textContent = text;
  }

  function renderStats() {
    var total = state.expenses.reduce(function (s, x) { return s + x.cents; }, 0);
    els.statTotal.textContent = fmt(total);
    els.statMeta.textContent = plural(state.people.length, 'person', 'people') + ' · ' +
      plural(state.expenses.length, 'expense', 'expenses');
  }

  function renderBalances(balances) {
    var n = balances.length;
    var hasExpenses = state.expenses.length > 0;
    els.balanceEmpty.hidden = n > 0;
    els.balanceList.hidden = n === 0;
    els.keelKey.hidden = !(n > 0 && hasExpenses);
    els.balanceLegend.hidden = !(n > 0 && hasExpenses);
    var max = balances.reduce(function (m, b) { return Math.max(m, Math.abs(b.balance)); }, 0);
    els.balanceList.replaceChildren.apply(els.balanceList, balances.map(function (b) {
      var c = b.balance;
      var tone = c > 0 ? 'pos' : (c < 0 ? 'neg' : 'zero');
      var detail = (b.paid === 0 && b.share === 0)
        ? 'Not part of any expense yet'
        : 'Paid ' + fmt(b.paid) + ' · share ' + fmt(b.share);
      var figure = el('p', { class: 'balance-figure' });
      if (c > 0) figure.append(el('span', { class: 'balance-word', text: 'is owed' }), el('span', { class: 'balance-amt', text: fmt(c) }));
      else if (c < 0) figure.append(el('span', { class: 'balance-word', text: 'owes' }), el('span', { class: 'balance-amt', text: fmt(-c) }));
      else figure.append(el('span', { class: 'balance-amt', text: 'Even' }));

      var li = el('li', {
        class: 'balance-row is-' + tone,
        'data-testid': 'balance',
        'data-person': b.person.name,
        'data-cents': String(c)
      },
        el('div', { class: 'balance-top' },
          avatarEl(b.person),
          el('div', { class: 'balance-who' },
            el('p', { class: 'balance-name', text: b.person.name }),
            el('p', { class: 'balance-detail', text: detail })
          ),
          figure
        )
      );
      var keel = el('div', { class: 'keel', 'aria-hidden': 'true' });
      if (c !== 0 && max > 0) {
        var bar = el('span', { class: 'keel-bar ' + tone });
        bar.style.width = Math.max(1.5, Math.abs(c) / max * 50) + '%';
        keel.append(bar);
      }
      li.append(keel);
      return li;
    }));
  }

  function renderSettle(balances) {
    var transfers = computeTransfers(balances);
    currentTransfers = transfers;
    var sub;
    if (!state.people.length) sub = 'Add people and expenses, and you’ll see who pays whom here.';
    else if (!state.expenses.length) sub = 'Nothing to settle yet. Once you log an expense, the payments that even things out show up here.';
    else if (!transfers.length) sub = 'Everyone’s even. Nothing to pay.';
    else if (transfers.length === 1) sub = 'One payment and everyone’s even.';
    else sub = transfers.length + ' payments and everyone’s even.';
    els.settleSub.textContent = sub;
    els.transferList.hidden = transfers.length === 0;
    els.copyRow.hidden = transfers.length === 0;
    els.transferList.replaceChildren.apply(els.transferList, transfers.map(function (t) {
      var from = nameOf(t.from);
      var to = nameOf(t.to);
      return el('li', {
        class: 'transfer', 'data-testid': 'transfer',
        'data-from': from, 'data-to': to, 'data-cents': String(t.cents)
      },
        el('p', { class: 'transfer-who' },
          el('span', { class: 'transfer-name', text: from }),
          el('span', { class: 'transfer-verb', text: ' pays ' }),
          el('span', { class: 'transfer-name', text: to })
        ),
        el('p', { class: 'transfer-amt', text: fmt(t.cents) })
      );
    }));
    var sig = transfers.map(function (t) { return t.from + '>' + t.to + ':' + t.cents; }).join('|');
    if (sig !== planSig) {
      planSig = sig;
      els.copyStatus.textContent = '';
    }
  }

  function renderExpenses() {
    var n = state.expenses.length;
    els.expensesCount.textContent = plural(n, 'expense', 'expenses');
    els.expensesCount.hidden = n === 0;
    els.expensesEmpty.hidden = n > 0;
    els.expenseList.hidden = n === 0;
    var items = state.expenses.slice().reverse().map(function (x) {
      var ids = sortIdsByTrip(x.splitIds, state.people);
      var names = ids.map(nameOf);
      var base = Math.floor(x.cents / names.length);
      var rem = x.cents - base * names.length;
      var each = names.length === 1 ? '' :
        (rem === 0 ? fmt(base) + ' each' : fmt(base) + ' or ' + fmt(base + 1) + ' each');
      var splitText = names.length === 1 ? 'Just for ' + names[0] : 'Split between ' + joinNames(names);
      return el('li', {
        class: 'expense' + (x.id === justAddedId ? ' is-new' : ''),
        'data-testid': 'expense', 'data-id': x.id
      },
        el('div', { class: 'expense-main' },
          el('p', { class: 'expense-desc', text: x.description }),
          el('p', { class: 'expense-meta' }, 'Paid by ', el('strong', { text: nameOf(x.payerId) })),
          el('p', { class: 'expense-meta' }, splitText + (each ? ' · ' + each : ''))
        ),
        el('div', { class: 'expense-side' },
          el('p', { class: 'expense-amt', text: fmt(x.cents) }),
          el('button', {
            type: 'button', class: 'link-btn', 'data-testid': 'delete-expense',
            'aria-label': 'Remove ' + x.description + ', ' + fmt(x.cents), text: 'Remove'
          })
        )
      );
    });
    els.expenseList.replaceChildren.apply(els.expenseList, items);
    justAddedId = null;
  }

  function renderUndo() {
    var key = lastRemoved ? lastRemoved.expense.id : null;
    if (key === renderedUndoKey) return;
    renderedUndoKey = key;
    if (!lastRemoved) { els.undoSlot.replaceChildren(); return; }
    var x = lastRemoved.expense;
    els.undoSlot.replaceChildren(el('div', { class: 'notice' },
      el('p', null, 'Removed ', el('strong', { text: '“' + x.description + '”' }), ' (' + fmt(x.cents) + ').'),
      el('button', { type: 'button', class: 'btn btn-quiet btn-small', 'data-undo': true, text: 'Undo' })
    ));
  }

  function renderReset() {
    var hasData = state.people.length > 0 || state.expenses.length > 0;
    els.reset.hidden = !hasData;
    if (!hasData) {
      els.resetConfirm.hidden = true;
      els.resetStart.hidden = false;
    }
  }

  function render() {
    renderSavedNote();
    renderPeople();
    renderFormOptions();
    updatePreview();
    var balances = computeBalances();
    renderStats();
    renderBalances(balances);
    renderSettle(balances);
    renderExpenses();
    renderUndo();
    renderReset();
  }

  function commit() { save(); render(); }

  /* ---------- People ---------- */

  els.personForm.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var name = els.personName.value.trim();
    if (!name) {
      showError('person', els.personErrorSlot, 'Enter a name to add someone to the trip.', { field: els.personName });
      return;
    }
    var key = nameKey(name);
    var dup = state.people.find(function (p) { return nameKey(p.name) === key; });
    if (dup) {
      showError('person', els.personErrorSlot,
        dup.name + ' is already on the trip. Names need to be different, so try adding a last initial, like “' + dup.name + ' B.”',
        { field: els.personName });
      return;
    }
    clearAllErrors();
    lastRemoved = null;
    state.people.push({ id: uid(), name: name });
    commit();
    els.personName.value = '';
    els.personName.focus();
    announce('Added ' + name + ' to the trip.');
  });

  els.personName.addEventListener('input', function () { clearError('person'); });

  els.peopleList.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var btn = e.target.closest('[data-remove-person]');
    if (!btn) return;
    var id = btn.getAttribute('data-remove-person');
    if (usedPersonIds().has(id)) return;
    var idx = state.people.findIndex(function (p) { return p.id === id; });
    if (idx < 0) return;
    var removed = state.people.splice(idx, 1)[0];
    unchecked.delete(id);
    lastRemoved = null;
    clearAllErrors();
    commit();
    var chips = els.peopleList.children;
    var chip = chips[idx] || chips[idx - 1];
    var target = chip ? chip.querySelector('[data-remove-person]') : null;
    (target || els.personName).focus();
    announce('Removed ' + removed.name + ' from the trip.');
  });

  /* ---------- Expenses ---------- */

  els.expenseForm.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    els.expenseStatus.textContent = '';
    if (!state.people.length) {
      showError('expense', els.expenseErrorSlot, 'Add the people on your trip first, in step 1. Then you can log what they paid for.', {});
      return;
    }
    var description = els.desc.value.trim();
    if (!description) {
      showError('expense', els.descErrorSlot, 'Add a short description, like “Groceries” or “Ferry tickets”.', { field: els.desc });
      return;
    }
    var parsed = parseAmount(els.amount.value);
    if (!parsed.ok) {
      showError('expense', els.rowErrorSlot, AMOUNT_MESSAGES[parsed.reason], { field: els.amount });
      return;
    }
    var payer = state.people.find(function (p) { return p.name === els.payer.value; });
    if (!payer) {
      showError('expense', els.rowErrorSlot, 'Choose who paid for this.', { field: els.payer });
      return;
    }
    var splitIds = checkedIds();
    if (!splitIds.length) {
      showError('expense', els.splitErrorSlot, 'Choose at least one person to split this with.', {
        group: els.splitFieldset, focus: checkboxes()[0]
      });
      return;
    }

    clearAllErrors();
    lastRemoved = null;
    var expense = {
      id: uid(), description: description, cents: parsed.cents,
      payerId: payer.id, splitIds: splitIds, createdAt: Date.now()
    };
    state.expenses.push(expense);
    justAddedId = expense.id;
    unchecked.clear();
    commit();

    els.desc.value = '';
    els.amount.value = '';
    checkboxes().forEach(function (c) { c.checked = true; });
    updatePreview();
    els.expenseStatus.textContent = 'Added “' + description + '” for ' + fmt(expense.cents) + ', paid by ' + payer.name + '.';
    els.desc.focus();
  });

  function onExpenseFormEdit(e) {
    if (e.type === 'input') els.expenseStatus.textContent = '';
    var er = errors.expense;
    if (!er) return;
    if ((er.field && er.field === e.target) || (er.group && er.group.contains(e.target))) clearError('expense');
  }
  els.expenseForm.addEventListener('input', onExpenseFormEdit);
  els.expenseForm.addEventListener('change', onExpenseFormEdit);

  els.amount.addEventListener('input', updatePreview);

  els.split.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
    var c = e.target;
    if (!c || c.type !== 'checkbox') return;
    var id = c.getAttribute('data-id');
    if (c.checked) unchecked.delete(id); else unchecked.add(id);
    updatePreview();
  });

  function setAllChecks(on) {
    checkboxes().forEach(function (c) {
      c.checked = on;
      var id = c.getAttribute('data-id');
      if (on) unchecked.delete(id); else unchecked.add(id);
    });
    updatePreview();
    els.expenseStatus.textContent = '';
    if (on && errors.expense && errors.expense.group === els.splitFieldset) clearError('expense');
  }
  els.splitAll.addEventListener('click', function () { setAllChecks(true); });
  els.splitNone.addEventListener('click', function () { setAllChecks(false); });

  els.expenseList.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var btn = e.target.closest('[data-testid="delete-expense"]');
    if (!btn) return;
    var li = btn.closest('li');
    var id = li ? li.getAttribute('data-id') : null;
    var index = state.expenses.findIndex(function (x) { return x.id === id; });
    if (index < 0) return;
    var displayIndex = Array.prototype.indexOf.call(els.expenseList.children, li);
    var removed = state.expenses.splice(index, 1)[0];
    lastRemoved = { expense: removed, index: index };
    clearAllErrors();
    commit();
    var buttons = els.expenseList.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="delete-expense"]');
    var next = buttons[displayIndex] || buttons[displayIndex - 1];
    (next || els.expensesTitle).focus();
  });

  els.undoSlot.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    if (!e.target.closest('[data-undo]') || !lastRemoved) return;
    var expense = lastRemoved.expense;
    var index = lastRemoved.index;
    var valid = personById(expense.payerId) && expense.splitIds.every(function (id) { return personById(id); });
    lastRemoved = null;
    if (!valid) { render(); els.expensesTitle.focus(); return; }
    state.expenses.splice(Math.min(index, state.expenses.length), 0, expense);
    clearAllErrors();
    commit();
    var li = Array.prototype.find.call(els.expenseList.children, function (node) {
      return node.getAttribute('data-id') === expense.id;
    });
    var btn = li ? li.querySelector('[data-testid="delete-expense"]') : null;
    (btn || els.expensesTitle).focus();
    announce('Restored “' + expense.description + '”.');
  });

  /* ---------- Copy the plan ---------- */

  function planText() {
    var total = state.expenses.reduce(function (s, x) { return s + x.cents; }, 0);
    var lines = ['Even Keel · settle up', 'Trip total: ' + fmt(total), ''];
    currentTransfers.forEach(function (t) {
      lines.push(nameOf(t.from) + ' pays ' + nameOf(t.to) + ' ' + fmt(t.cents));
    });
    return lines.join('\n');
  }

  function fallbackCopy(text) {
    var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = text;
    ta.setAttribute('readonly', '');
    ta.style.position = 'fixed';
    ta.style.top = '0';
    ta.style.left = '0';
    ta.style.width = '1px';
    ta.style.height = '1px';
    ta.style.opacity = '0';
    document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.select();
    var ok = false;
    try { ok = document.execCommand('copy'); } catch (err) { ok = false; }
    ta.remove();
    els.copyBtn.focus();
    return ok;
  }

  els.copyBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    var text = planText();
    function done(ok) {
      els.copyStatus.textContent = ok
        ? 'Copied. Paste it into your group chat.'
        : 'Couldn’t copy automatically. You can select the list and copy it.';
    }
    if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(function () { done(true); }, function () { done(fallbackCopy(text)); });
    } else {
      done(fallbackCopy(text));
    }
  });

  /* ---------- New trip ---------- */

  function closeReset(focusStart) {
    els.resetConfirm.hidden = true;
    els.resetStart.hidden = false;
    if (focusStart) els.resetStart.focus();
  }
  els.resetStart.addEventListener('click', function () {
    els.resetStart.hidden = true;
    els.resetConfirm.hidden = false;
    els.resetNo.focus();
  });
  els.resetNo.addEventListener('click', function () { closeReset(true); });
  els.resetConfirm.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); closeReset(true); }
  });
  els.resetYes.addEventListener('click', function () {
    state = emptyState();
    unchecked.clear();
    lastRemoved = null;
    clearAllErrors();
    els.personName.value = '';
    els.desc.value = '';
    els.amount.value = '';
    els.expenseStatus.textContent = '';
    commit();
    closeReset(false);
    els.personName.focus();
    announce('Started a new trip. Everyone and every expense was cleared.');
  });

  /* ---------- Other tabs ---------- */

  window.addEventListener('storage', function (e) {
    if (e.key !== null && e.key !== STORAGE_KEY) return;
    state = load();
    lastRemoved = null;
    clearAllErrors();
    render();
  });

  render();
})();
</script>
